name: Automotive Repair Systems UAE
headline: SMART Dent Repair in Dubai
lede: Automotive Repair Systems LLC, Al Quoz: dent repair Dubai, paintless dent repair, smart scratch repair and colour-matched car painting since 1997.
about: A dent does not always need new paint. We first assess whether paintless repair can restore the panel while keeping intact factory paint. When repainting is necessary, careful preparation, colour matching and blending help restore the finish. Our Al Quoz body specialists work on luxury cars and every other brand.

Dent repair and paint repair are our focus. We assess paintless methods to protect intact factory paint wherever suitable, and use targeted preparation, colour matching and blending when painting is needed. Explore our other body-care services below.
